summary: Prove complete assembly entry correctness and execution existence through the actual guard, loaded cursor range, absolute-counter loop, boundary mask, store and return.

examined.reason: Compose the actual entry with no supplied ready execution, loop result or iteration count. Derive one stored word and unchanged other bytes; handle padded return and prove general existence.
Record complete snapshot assembly contracts and exact emitted-entry binding while retaining concurrent publication and launch obligations.
No equations, TorchLean calculation, emitted kernel or host algorithm changed.

Reviewed both directions of fetched-loop traversal, actual loaded bounds, unsigned cursor termination, node/base preservation, boundary flag meaning, exact final write and inactive early return. The code checker binds declarations, launch shape and native targets. Snapshot source conditions are explicit; there is no new hardware or full PTX admission claim.

results.method: Complete registered Lean build; fresh AssemblyEntryChecks kernel regressions; exact dependency audit; source guards and pins; complete emitted assembly/cell binding on saved runs; 27 Python Poisson tests; Stratic validation and manual contract review.
results.environment: Lean 4.34.0; 16 verified dependency pins; CPU proof checks and saved GPU artifacts, without GPU reruns or paid calls.
results.evidence: 4267 exact audited declarations, only standard Lean axioms; 476 guarded files. Whole active assembly entry output correctness and finite execution existence; padding correctness/existence without allocated inputs; fresh cancellation, mask, padding and invalid-access tests. Both complete assembly entries (60 total) and native branches bound across 30 layouts, alongside 90 complete cell entries and previous residual binding. 418 receipt source hashes verified; 27 Python tests pass. Identical before/after snapshots, Stratic valid, README unchanged. Concurrent assembly publication, input serialization and solver/launch correspondence remain explicit.
